description.value: Jasper is a modernized 1960s-style A-frame cottage on the forested 20-acre grounds of Nectar Yoga Retreat on Bowen Island, a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The retreat blends Scandinavian-inspired simplicity with wellness programming; every stay includes daily breakfast and yoga and meditation lessons. In 2025 the property added the Mist Thermal Sanctuary offering sauna and cold plunge experiences in the heart of the forest.

address.value: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC, V0N 1G2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies 'Jasper' as a single A-frame cottage operated by Nectar Yoga Retreat on Bowen Island; the website confirms 'Jasper' is one of three A-frames (Sunstone, Jasper, Opal) at 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC. No bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or cyclist-specific facilities are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content. Wi-Fi is confirmed as an in-room amenity for the deluxe cottages and Moonstone cottage; the A-frame amenity list was truncated in the fetched content but the property consistently lists Wi-Fi across cottage types.
concerns: OSM record names only the individual cottage 'Jasper' rather than the parent property 'Nectar Yoga Retreat'; consider whether the OSM record should be superseded by a property-level listing.
OSM community tag says 'Vancouver' but the property is on Bowen Island — a separate municipality.
Address, phone, and email are absent from OSM tags; all contact details sourced exclusively from the website footer (720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2; 604-947-6999; Info@nectaryoga.ca).
A-frame cottage amenity list was truncated in the fetched website content; some amenities (including explicit Wi-Fi confirmation for A-frames) could not be fully verified.
No mention of bike storage, bike-friendly staff, or any cycling infrastructure anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Nectar Yoga Retreat is legitimate, operating accommodation on Bowen Island, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website, making a directory inclusion call impossible without direct contact.
enrichment_extras.notes: Daily breakfast is included with all cottage stays per the website ('Includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation lessons'), but the format (early/packed/buffet) is not specified so 'Early or packed breakfast' was left null. The retreat also offers work-trade programs (Digital Skills and Outdoor Skills) which may be relevant context for longer-stay cyclists.
